title: FIND: A Simple yet Effective Baseline for Diffusion-Generated Image Detection
key_findings: FIND improves performance by 11.7% on the GenImage benchmark while running 126x faster than existing reconstruction-based methods.
Eliminates the need for auxiliary diffusion models and costly reconstruction by using a simple binary classifier trained with noise-augmented real images.
research_problem: Overcoming the high computational cost and model-dependency of reconstruction-based diffusion image detectors by exploiting core distributional differences between real and synthetic images.
usefulness_reason: Presents a highly efficient, lightweight baseline (FIND) that removes auxiliary reconstruction steps and runs significantly faster than existing methods.
